name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 4 visits over 10 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 10 hours starting 2026-06-03, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.77 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
